journal.title: Current sheet formation under radiative cooling

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The preprint equation ends after rho_dot+rho(Gamma_x+Gamma_y), with no equality. The journal explicitly prints =0.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: A later audit should not attribute the preprint missing equality to the final article.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The preprint uses gamma and delta in this asymptotic line; the journal uses Gamma_x and Gamma_y. The xi,rho,j exponents are retained.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: This is a notation correction; no changed numerical solution is inferred.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The arXiv source explicitly uses a cross product; the journal PDF and publisher tex-math HTML explicitly show a dot product and add psi=-A_z.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: Treat as a source-definition/typesetting difference to check, not evidence that a numerical implementation used a dot product.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The journal adds that power-law cooling exponents beyond bremsstrahlung may require fits to tabular cooling curves, and magnetic-field-dependent cooling needs slowly varying beta for this parameterization.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: These caveats belong to the final source and must be credited.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The journal adds an explicit statement that detailed Crab-Nebula applications require relativistic corrections.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: Do not present the final source as silently claiming full Newtonian applicability there.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The journal explicitly says Newtonian MHD, adds possible extensions to non-MHD systems and cites qualitatively thinner current sheets in existing radiative PIC studies. Numerical verification of this paper is still described as a future direction.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: The cited external PIC comparison is not a deposited independent reproduction of this analytic/numerical model.

confirmed_edition_changes.observed_fact: The preprint abstract cites Uzdensky and McKinney2011. The final abstract prints1962 while the final body and reference entry on p25 identify the same work as2011.
confirmed_edition_changes.interpretation_limit: This is a local bibliographic discrepancy, not a finding about the cooling model.

retained_source_assertions_for_later_rev.observed_fact: The C1/C2 pressure representation, assertion of unconstrained spatial C2, and the displayed AppendixA differentiation/integration forms remain in the final source.
R is defined as outflow-time/cooling-time; the displayed R expression contains Gamma_y,0 as a multiplier, and the subsequent cooling-constant expression is retained.
The bremsstrahlung exponent alpha approximately1 and the phrase eta much less than xi near tc remain, alongside eta approximately eta(tc).
A approximately1+beta_in, the layer-length/rate/thickness scalings and the contrast with Uzdensky–McKinney thermal instability remain.
